notes: - Incoming voice notes now open. On the real Messages page a voice note is a custom player with no file address until it plays — the assistant received the note, found nothing to download, and honestly told the person 'I couldn't open your voice note'. Now, when a voice note (or video) arrives with no direct address, the assistant presses play on it in the page and captures the sound as it loads — from the playback's network traffic, or from the player element the page creates in order to play it — then pauses it again. The AI receives the actual audio, like it already did for pictures.
